Collect, validate, reconcile, and analyze healthcare, finance, cost accounting, and operational data to ensure accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting sources.

Develop and maintain routine and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and analyses that support operational, financial, cost accounting, service line, and decision support needs.

Prepare revenue, expense, utilization, profitability, contribution margin, service line, cost trend, and pro-forma analyses to support financial planning and performance review.

Support the development, maintenance, monthly processing, and validation of decision support models, cost models, reporting tools, data structures, cost accounting hierarchies, cost center mappings, and chart of account relationships.

Reconcile cost accounting system results and model outputs to the general ledger, financial statements, ancillary feeder systems, and other source systems; identify variances, root causes, corrections, and methodology refinements.

Develop, maintain, document, and periodically validate methodologies for assigning direct costs and allocating overhead, indirect costs, shared services, support departments, and other expenses across departments, service lines, procedures, programs, and reporting dimensions.

Review allocation statistics, cost drivers, source data, expense classifications, cost center assignments, and data mappings; recommend reclassifications or mapping changes to improve cost reporting and financial analytics.

Support department, service line, procedure-level, and patient-level cost models, including documentation of assumptions, data sources, allocation calculations, reconciliations, process controls, and methodology changes for management review or audit support.

Partner with Finance, operational leaders, senior analysts, Information Technology, and other stakeholders to understand reporting needs, validate data, automate processes, explain allocation results, and deliver actionable decision support solutions.

Support annual budget, forecasting, financial planning, service line analysis, process improvement, reporting standardization, automation initiatives, department projects, and other assigned initiatives.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

Title: Sr Enterprise Data & Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Is it surprising to hear that a financial institution of 1.5 million members and over $30 billion in managed assets say that success comes from focusing on people, not profits?

Our “people helping people” philosophy has guided us since 1935, driving our deep commitment to serving our members, communities, and each other. When you join our team, you become part of a purpose-driven organization where your work makes a real difference.

While we’re proud of our history, we’re even more excited about our future. With business and technology transformation on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to be part of BECU.

You bring more than your expertise to your role, and that matters here. Your story, perspectives, and lived experiences help shape belonging at BECU and deepen how we connect with and support our employees, our members, and our communities.

PAY RANGE

The Target Pay Range for this position is $128,900.00-$157,500.00 annually. The full Pay Range is $99,900.00 - $186,400.00 annually. At BECU, compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer for employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

BENEFITS – Because People Helping People Starts With Supporting You


401(k) Company Match (up to 3%)
4% annual contribution to your 401(k) by BECU
Medical, Dental and Vision (family contributions as well)
PTO Program + Exchange Program
Tuition Reimbursement Program
BECU Cares volunteer time off + donation match


To join our dynamic team, we require candidates to be residents of WA, CA, VA, NC, OR, ID, AZ, TX, GA, or SC. If you’re located in Washington state and within a reasonable driving distance from Tukwila, we are requesting that you come into our HQ on Tuesdays & Wednesdays.  For those candidates that live outside the commute distance of TFC and in any of our approved remote work locations, this role will be remote. Remote or onsite, we are committed to ensuring you are fully engaged and included in our collaborative environment. 

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

Help shape how one of the nation's largest credit unions tells its data story.

As a Sr. Enterprise Data & Business Intelligence Analyst, you'll play a key role in advancing BECU's enterprise data visualization capabilities by designing intuitive, impactful, and scalable reporting solutions that help leaders make smarter decisions. You'll partner with analytics teams, business leaders, and BI engineers across the organization to transform complex data into meaningful stories that influence strategy at every level—including executive leadership.

This role is about much more than building dashboards. You'll champion best practices in data visualization, help establish enterprise reporting standards, mentor fellow analysts, and introduce innovative ideas that elevate how BECU communicates with data. If you're passionate about the art and science of data storytelling, enjoy teaching others, and are always exploring new ways to make data more accessible and actionable, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

What You’ll Do


Design intuitive, visually compelling dashboards and reporting solutions using Tableau and Power BI that enable enterprise decision-making.
Transform complex business questions into clear, meaningful data stories that drive action across Marketing, Finance, Treasury, Risk, Product, and other business functions.
Partner with business leaders, analysts, BI engineers, and technical teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable reporting solutions that meet enterprise needs.
Champion enterprise data visualization standards, governance practices, and design principles that improve consistency, usability, and trust in reporting.
Help administer Tableau and Power BI environments, including permissions, content organization, governance, and platform best practices.
Guide analysts across the organization by mentoring on dashboard design, storytelling techniques, accessibility, and visualization best practices.
Evaluate emerging visualization trends, tools, and industry practices to continuously improve BECU's reporting capabilities and user experience.
Conduct technical demonstrations, knowledge-sharing sessions, and presentations with stakeholders ranging from analysts to executive leadership.
Collaborate with Enterprise Data Management, BI Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure high-quality, trusted, and well-governed enterprise reporting solutions.
Support data governance initiatives by promoting high-quality datasets, visualization standards, and consistent reporting practices across the organization.
Perform additional duties as assigned.


This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.

What You’ll Gain


The opportunity to shape the future of enterprise data visualization at one of the nation's largest credit unions.
The ability to influence enterprise reporting standards, dashboard design, and visualization best practices across multiple business functions.
Opportunities to mentor fellow analysts and share your expertise with a collaborative, enterprise-wide analytics community.
Exposure to executive stakeholders while helping communicate strategic business insights through impactful data storytelling.
Hands-on experience with leading business intelligence platforms including Tableau, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric.
A collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous learning, and bringing new ideas from across the data visualization community.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Mathematics, or related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum 7 years of experience delivering enterprise business intelligence, reporting, and analytics solutions, including designing interactive dashboards and data visualizations using Tableau and Power BI.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into intuitive, scalable reporting and visualization solutions.
Working knowledge of SQL and experience supporting enterprise business intelligence environments, including data preparation, visualization governance, permissions, and platform administration.
Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across technical and business audiences.


Desired Qualifications


Advanced degree preferred.
Experience working within large, enterprise organizations or consulting environments supporting multiple business partners.
Experience establishing visualization standards, governance practices, or enterprise reporting best practices.
Experience participating in Tableau User Groups, Data Visualization Society, industry conferences, or other professional visualization communities.
Experience with Python, Alteryx, or other data preparation tools preferred.


JOIN THE JOURNEY

Ready to make an indelible impact? Eager to be part of a collaborative and innovative team where your ideas and contributions don’t just fill a role but fuel the growth and success of BECU? This is more than a job – it’s a chance to elevate your career, skills, and future, all while contributing to the robust operational landscape of BECU.

Embrace the opportunity to grow with us. Apply now, bring your expertise to the table, and let’s achieve excellence together at BECU. Your journey of influence, innovation, and impactful contribution starts now. #BECU #YourGrowth #BECUJourney

EEO Statement

BECU is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

Title: Program Data Analyst
Description:
Tesla Laboratories is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Cyber Security, Intelligence Analysis, Financial Management, Facilities Engineering Services, and Program Management support to the Intelligence Community (IC), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal government customers. We take pride in fostering a culture that values family, professional growth, and long-term career development—setting us apart from other services companies.

Requirements

Tesla Laboratories is seeking a Program/Data Analyst to support Design Technical Support (DTS) services for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest (NAVFAC NW), Planning Design and Construction Directorate, Design Division (PDC4). This position supports the existing NAVFAC workforce and provides increased capability for Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build projects and associated efforts undertaken by NAVFAC Northwest customers within the NAVFAC Northwest Area of Responsibility (Puget Sound area).

Perform program/data analysis tasks, including:


Data analytics related to tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Tracking financial metrics of success for construction and engineering-related projects
Budget tracking and execution metric presentation


In addition, the Program/Data Analyst will:


Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements
Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.)
Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes
Research codes, guidance, policies, procedures, processes, criteria, and federal laws/regulations, and provide sound technical recommendations both verbally and in writing
Apply innovative technical principles, practices, and theories to the resolution of technical issues
Coordinate with the Government client, NAVFAC team members, leadership, project stakeholders, and various regulatory agencies
Coordinate and facilitate meetings, make recommendations based on project requirements, coordinate workflow processes, schedule/coordinate Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and effectively communicate findings to project personnel; provide written minutes for all meetings
Review technical reports, RFIs, designs, design changes (design-build and design-bid-build), project deliverables, submittals, and cost proposals from contractors to ensure compliance with customer and RFP requirements
Provide technical support for review of the commissioning plan, design and construction submittals, and field inspections
Provide technical support for construction field activities
Provide a summary of accomplishments during weekly meetings and in a prepared monthly status report
Provide weekly reports documenting technical engineering support and quality assurance on each assigned project, including status, issues, costs, schedule, and findings/observations/recommendations/data collected
Prepare reports, Requests for Proposals, and/or scopes of work in the required format, including applicable attachments, and participate in briefings/conferences
Prepare and deliver briefs supported by necessary project documentation to project team members, base personnel, and senior management
Ensure timely submission of submittals, reviews, and recommendations


Minimum of 5 years of financial management experience in a field related to the tasks described above.

Benefits

Tesla Laboratories offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and long-term success of our employees, including:

Competitive compensation

Health, dental, and vision insurance

Retirement plan with company contribution

Paid time off and federal holidays

Professional development and training opportunities

Supportive, family-focused company culture

Opportunities for long-term career growth within a growing SDVOSB

Title: Business Systems Analyst - Population Health
Description:
Job Description

UW Medicine Department of Analytics for Quality, Population Health and Value has an outstanding opportunity for a Business Systems Analyst.

WORK SCHEDULE


HYBRID opportunity (one day onsite/week)
100% FTE
Monday – Friday; Core hours are 8:00AM – 5:00PM (PST)


Department Description

The UW Medicine Department of Analytics for Quality, Population Health and Value supports a wide range of data collection, analysis, and reporting activities across UW Medicine. UW Medicine’s Chief Quality Office, Department of Analytics for Quality, Population Health and Value is a shared services organization that supports all of UW Medicine. Value Based Analytics is responsible for providing analytics support in value-based contracting by facilitating data workflows and creating tools and reporting that facilitate and support strategic decision making and internal goal setting and tracking.

This position reports to the UW Medicine Director of Analytics for Quality, Population Health, and Value and plays an integral role in data management, reporting process improvement, and operational support. The position works closely across UW Medicine’s healthcare system, collaborating with population health affiliated departments, contracting, IT Services and Epic departments, UW Medicine stakeholders, and external organizations.

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS


15 days of vacation your first year – Also, 12 days of sick time, 1 personal holiday, and 11 paid holidays each year
100% matching, 100% immediately vesting 403(b)


Primary Job Responsibilities


Provides data programming and analytics in support of physician and system leadership, encompassing quality, financial, and utilization reporting, population health tools, value measurement, and ad hoc analyses
Apply expert-level SQL database development skills, including SSRS/SSIS and other Microsoft platform technologies, to deliver high-quality reporting solutions and dashboards
Designs, codes, tests, and maintains BI/reporting and analytics objects using industry best practices

Title: Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer retention.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
2+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
1+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00

Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Title: SCS Business & Customer Insights Analyst II
Description:
Overview

The SCS (Sales & Customer Support) CX Insights Analyst II contributes to REI’s success by providing critical data insights, trends and analysis to enable data driven decision making, improve customer experiences across all SCS touchpoints, and support the evolution of the SCS team as we leverage technology to provide a seamless blend of expert human guidance and technology enabled solutions. The role acts a relentless advocate for our customers across their journey, identifying friction trends, quality and process improvements and utilizes voice of customer feedback/sentiment to drive action and prioritization of enterprise customer initiatives. The Analyst’s primary focus will be to complete recurring analysis, identify root causes of customer issues/pain points, and deliver concise, impactful summary of findings. Models and acts in accordance with the Co-op Way (values & mission).

Responsibilities And Qualifications

Responsibilities:


Analyze, report, and track information to identify data patterns and customer pain points using multiple data sources, including structured and unstructured customer research, benchmarks, demographics, and internal operational data.
Support SCS team share-outs with distilled insights from SCS CX Programs and listening channels to drive actionable, data-driven recommendations.
Engage in dialogue with stakeholders to understand the scope and impact of potential causes or changes to the customer experience, aiding in the interpretation of insights.
Participate in processes that drive ongoing evaluation and improvement in our listening programs, tools and dashboards (Customer intent/topic data, VOC, Quality Management).
Contribute to developing program solutions, including technical implementation of new technology platforms, systems, tools, vendor onboarding and management, integration, and ongoing data integrity maintenance of the SCS ecosystem. Requires understanding of tools (e.g., Qualtrics, Sigma, Digital Analytics - Adobe, Tealium).
Support managers with internal partner consultation, project coordination and execution, annual research, and budget planning.
Provide collaborative ad-hoc decision support and represent the voice and needs of customers among internal partners.
Monitor and evaluate accuracy and efficacy of listening tools, LLMS and sentiment analysis.
Perform regular deep dives and root cause analyses of top customer pain points.
Leverage metrics, feedback, and other data to understand the customer experience, identifying pain points and opportunities for improvement.



Qualifications:


A college degree (Bachelor’s or equivalent work experience) is required with data analytics, data science, business analytics, statistics, or marketing analytics and research focus.
5+ years of experience in similar business analytics, data science or insight roles preferably within retail/customer service.
Industry knowledge Quality, VOC, customer experience (CX), analytics, data, marketing, or other relevant experience/certifications.

Title: Go-To-Market Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

Title: RCM Performance Analyst
Description:
Epic RCM Performance Analyst

Position Summary

Join Deloitte's AI & Engineering practice to deliver back-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) services, including Billing and Claims Submission, A/R Follow-up, Denials Management, Payment Posting, and Credits and Refunds, for health care provider client

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/01/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Epic RCM Performance Analyst on the AI & Engineering team, you will develop and maintain KPI reporting and dashboards tracking denial rates, AR aging, remittance trends, and productivity and quality performance across the operations team. Analyze 835/277 remittance and claims data using Epic Resolute and BI reporting tools to identify high-impact denial categories, payer-specific patterns, and systemic billing variances. Build and maintain Excel-based models and BI reports / dashboards to convert raw claims and remittance data into audit-ready, decision-useful insights. Conduct ongoing trend analysis and root-cause sampling of denial, variance, and productivity data to isolate systemic, payer, or process-driven issues. Partner with quality assurance, training, and operations leadership to validate findings and confirm root causes prior to remediation. Monitor payer guideline and requirement changes and assess their downstream impact on denial trends and account processing performance. Collaborate with operational teams to translate analytic findings into targeted process improvement recommendations and remediation plans. Supporting implementation of remediation plans by working with staff and team leads to confirming corrective actions are applied and sustained. Track the effectiveness of interventions over time and refine analytic and reporting approach based on outcomes. Develop clear, data-driven materials and presentations for internal leadership and client stakeholders summarizing KPI performance, trends, and recommended actions. Support monthly and quarterly business reviews with root-cause narratives, performance summaries, and improvement recommendations. Present analytic findings to varied audiences, from operational staff to client and engagement leadership. A successful candidate would possess these skills:


Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines


The team

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Our Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We deliver integrated business expertise with scalable, repeatable technology solutions specifically engineered for each sector.

Qualifications

Required:


3+ years of experience in back-end revenue cycle operations, with working knowledge of core functions (claims, denials, AR follow-up, credits, payment posting)
Hands-on experience with Epic Resolute Hospital Billing and claims clearinghouse systems, including tracing 835/277 remittance data
Demonstrated experience conducting root-cause and translating findings into recommended process improvements
Advanced Excel skills with familiarity in Epic Analytics/Reporting or other BI reporting tools
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate KPI, quality, and productivity data into actionable insights
Experience developing reporting materials and presentations for internal leadership and/or client audiences
Clear, confident communicator able to present findings and recommendations to varied audience sizes


Preferred:


Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Experience supporting clinical or healthcare business operations
Experience managing multiple projects or workstreams
Experience preparing and delivering technical demonstrations
Experience analyzing billing workflows, claim issues, or operational data


The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $70,000 to $90,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst, Audience & Lifecycle
Description:
Classmates.com has spent 30 years helping people reconnect with meaningful parts of their past. The demand has endured, the data has compounded, and the opportunity now is to become much more intelligent about how we create personalized experiences for individual members, graduating classes, and communities connected by shared history.




We’re looking for a systems thinker who can work from source eventing through business decisions. You’ll help shape the data inputs, define and activate audiences, design experiments, analyze results, and work with leaders across Marketing, Product, BI/Data, and Engineering to turn evidence into better customer experiences.




This is hands-on work across large-scale consumer data and production activation systems. You’ll work directly in Snowflake and Salesforce Marketing Cloud, where the quality of the data, audience logic, experiment design, and interpretation all matter because the resulting decisions affect millions of real consumers.




Local area candidates are encouraged to apply, and please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship, visa transfer, or corp-corp arrangements.

Responsibilities
Build, validate, and operate audience segmentation and activation workflows in Salesforce Marketing Cloud across lifecycle programs.
Work directly with large-scale behavioral, lifecycle, transactional, engagement, and event data in Snowflake to identify meaningful audience patterns and opportunities.
Help shape the source eventing and data inputs needed to answer important customer and business questions, partnering closely with Product, BI, and Engineering.
Design rigorous experiments, analyze results, and use what we learn to continuously improve audience strategy, lifecycle experiences, and personalization.
Build clear reporting and communicate findings to leaders so evidence can move quickly into decisions, operational rules, and better product experiences.




Skills and Experience 
5+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience supporting production lifecycle programs, including audience segmentation and activation.
Strong experience in lifecycle marketing analytics, audience segmentation, and marketing automation operations.
Meaningful experience in consumer marketing or consumer product environments, working with individual customer behavior and lifecycle signals at scale.
Advanced SQL skills and strong hands-on Snowflake experience working directly with large customer datasets.
Strong analytical and reporting capability, including the ability to investigate ambiguous problems, validate data, interpret results, and communicate findings clearly to business and technical leaders.
Hands-on experience designing and evaluating experiments, including incrementality, statistical testing, or other rigorous measurement approaches.
Curious, driven, and energized by solving ambiguous, high-impact problems with smart, collaborative people.

Title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack (Strategic Revenue Insights)
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Revenue Team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About The Role

We’re looking for intelligent, driven professionals to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team is responsible for comprehensive analyses, reporting, and data solutions to support and grow our Revenue segments.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem solving skills, the ability to craft comprehensive narratives for both internal and external stakeholders, and produce tools and solutions to scale data usage with Revenue. In addition to analytical rigor, the ideal candidate has strong interpersonal skills to work proactively within the organization and with clients to drive forward recommendations.

What You’ll Do

Optimize decisions and execution with analyses, and communicate to internal and external partners


Be a strategic partner with our Client Success and Marketplace Teams as the data SME for respective Revenue segments and merchants for their point-of-sale and Marketplace business
Create business cases, insights, and dashboards as well as handle experiments to engage Affirm’s external merchant base; demonstrating Affirm’s value proposition and product performance
Create internal analyses to assess Revenue performance, drive recommendations, and inform critical decisions; using insights to serve segment strategy and execution


Scale impact


Standardize common use cases, provide the analytics infrastructure, and automate analyses and dashboards to scale decisions and execution within Revenue and with top external merchants


Own comprehensive analytics solution


Define KPIs, performance benchmarks, and methodologies, including identifying and working with unstructured and structured data sources (in-house and third-party) to enable solutions and generate actionable insights
Provide project and analytics guidance to a cross-functional team, acting as the analytics point of contact
Propose, monitor, and contextualize experiment design and execution to drive optimizations of Affirm’s GTM efforts, empirically quantify the value of Affirm to our prospective merchants, and upsell enhanced offers to existing merchants


What We Look For


5+ years of experience in an analytically-driven role (consulting, finance, analytics, etc.)
Strong working knowledge of SQL, data visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Looker, Tableau). Understanding or a demonstrated aptitude to learn Python is a plus
Demonstrated aptitude in leveraging AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)
Exceptional problem-solving skills, including ability to operate in ambiguity and establishing analytical frameworks to apply to business problems
Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations, such as aligning stakeholders, or choosing the most impactful data to drive decisions
Ability to communicate effectively, and craft compelling narratives to influence business and technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization, internally and externally
Strong organization and execution skills, including ability to operate independently and drive multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously to drive business goals
Prior track record in building successful cross-functional relationships with partners internally and externally
Self-starter and a track record of successfully driving projects from end to end (from building strategy to implementation)
Passion and drive to disrupt both the retail and lending industry for the better
Enough laziness to find a faster way to do your least favorite tasks
Humility and a team player - you go out of your way to help teammates


Nice to Have


Knowledge of the FinTech or Payments industry
Prior experience performing data analytics for marketplace platforms
Demonstrated aptitude in AI tools for analytics (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)


Pay Grade - M

Equity Grade - 8

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $185,000 - $245,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $164,000 - $224,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Title: Commercial Operations Analyst (onsite in Bothell, WA)
Description:
The Data Analyst supports the business by partnering closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D teams to deliver insights, reporting, and process improvements. Our team operates as an internal service organization — we exist to make our partner departments faster, smarter, and more data-informed. This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Success in this role comes from pairing the right applications with the right processes, used in unison. Strong tools without disciplined process produce one-off answers that don’t scale; strong process without the right tools slows the business down. The analysts who thrive here do both — picking the right system for the question (Tableau, Excel, Oracle, Salesforce, Eloqua, GA4, Qualtrics), then wrapping it in clear scoping, documentation, stakeholder review, and automation so the work compounds over time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point-of-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms.

We’re looking for purpose-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and a passion for life-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together.

Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description

Essential Job Functions:


Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau Server to support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and R&D.
Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, ask clarifying questions, and translate business questions into actionable analyses.
Build and maintain forecast models and own the forecasting process end-to-end — consolidating inputs from Sales, Product, and Marketing into a clear view of performance by product category and geography and applying historical trend analysis to improve forecast accuracy over time.
Develop pricing models to evaluate new-product pricing and validate margin targets, partnering with Application Analysts to load approved pricing accurately into Oracle and Salesforce.
Work with Oracle EBS data sources made available via Tableau; develop a working understanding of the system to interpret and contextualize the data accurately.
Pull and analyze data from Salesforce Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, quotes) to support sales reporting and forecasting.
Develop email marketing reporting using Oracle Eloqua, partnering with Marketing to track campaign performance and engagement metrics.
Analyze on-page web analytics using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to support marketing and product decisions.
Design, deploy, and analyze surveys in Qualtrics; turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
Use Excel extensively for ad hoc analysis, modeling, and stakeholder-facing deliverables.
Identify and execute opportunities to reduce manual effort across the organization — automating recurring reports, simplifying workflows, and eliminating one-off data pulls.
Partner with the Data Governance team to support reliable data pipelines and consistent, trustworthy data ingestion.
Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and reporting issues; favor proactive reporting over reactive firefighting.
Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to senior leadership with a clear narrative arc — leading with the takeaway, tailoring the message to the audience, and using clean visuals to drive confident, data-informed decisions.
Document processes, data definitions, and standard operating procedures using Oracle Agile and Microsoft Loop to enable knowledge transfer and team continuity.
Manage multiple concurrent requests; pull work proactively from the team backlog and move projects forward without needing step-by-step direction.
Build stakeholder review cycles into project timelines — share drafts with enough lead time to incorporate feedback rather than pushing deliverables out at the last minute.


Knowledge And Experience


2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud reporting (leads, opportunities, quotes).
Experience with Oracle Eloqua (or equivalent) for email marketing reporting and campaign analytics.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for web and on-page analytics.
Working knowledge of Oracle EBS as a business system (modules, workflows, terminology).
Demonstrated experience automating manual reporting or processes.
Experience with Google BigQuery, particularly for interfacing with GA4 data exports.
Familiarity with Qualtrics for survey design and analysis.


Skills/Abilities


Proficiency with Tableau (Desktop and Server) building dashboards, publishing, working with extracts and permissions.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas, basic modeling).
Basic SQL knowledge — comfortable reading queries and writing simple SELECT/JOIN statements.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to executives, including C-suite leadership.
Strong time and project management skills — including proactive planning for stakeholder review and feedback cycles.
Self-starter mindset: comfortable pulling work from a backlog, clarifying scope with the manager and stakeholders, and driving tasks to completion independently.
Strong documentation skills and a commitment to knowledge sharing.
Exposure to data governance & data architecture concepts.
Familiarity with ETL or data prep tools (Tableau Prep, Alteryx, Python/Pandas, dbt).
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to enhance analyst workflows — drafting, summarizing, accelerating analysis, or generating code.


Salary And Benefits


$75,000.00/yr - $95,000.00/yr depending on experience (Compensation will vary based on skills, experience and location; it is not typical to be hired at or above the top of the salary range).
Insurance:
Medical, Dental & Vision
Life & Company paid Disability
Retirement Plan (401k):
4% automatic Company contribution
Fujifilm matches 50 cents for every dollar you contribute, up to 6% of your salary
Paid Time Off:
You can accrue up to 120 hours of PTO in your first year of employment
PTO increases based on years of service
Employee Choice Holidays:
32 hours additional paid time off, based on date of hire in the calendar year
Paid Holidays:
Eight (8) paid holidays per year

Description:
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:


Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
Holidays: 13 paid days per year


Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
4 years of experience in data analytics, Trust and Safety, policy, cybersecurity, or related fields.


Preferred qualifications:


Master's degree in relevant field.
Experience with machine learning.
Experience in SQL, building dashboards, data collection/transformation, visualization, or experience in a scripting/programming language (e.g. Python).
Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills and the ability to influence cross-functionally at various levels.


About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

In this role, you will be responsible for safeguarding the Google Ads ecosystem. Your role is a blend of technical data analysis, strategic cross-functional leadership, and direct investigative work. You will use data to predict their next moves, influence how engineering teams build detection systems, and ensure that safety measures do not disrupt the experience for legitimate advertisers.

We are on a critical mission to protect Google's users and ensure online safety across core and emerging Ads products. Our team is at the forefront of raising the bar on content through coherent policies and scaled, effective enforcement. We have expanded beyond traditional product protections to manage emerging challenges—including brand safety and controversial content across Google's growing Ads ecosystem.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $116000 - $166000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Collaborate with cross-functional groups such as Product Manager (PM), Engineering, Sales and Legal to drive projects that increases users' safety and provide better online experience through Google Ads.
Execute complex queries and analyses, build visual models, and construct presentations on abuse trends to aid in fraud prevention and influence change in existing abuse detection systems without compromising advertiser experience.
Conduct investigations to catch fraudsters, enforce our product policies, learn scam patterns/trends and identify product vulnerabilities.
Identify automation and efficiency opportunities and drive solutions through analysis or cross-functional partnerships.
Perform on-call responsibilities on a rotating basis, including weekend coverage/holidays. This role works with sensitive content or situations and may be exposed to graphic, controversial, or upsetting topics or content.

Title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Intelligence
Description:
The Sr Analyst, Workforce Intelligence serves as the analytics and insights partner to Fortive Talent Partners and OpCo HR teams. The role transforms employee listening, workforce, talent, organization, and work data into actionable insights and recommendations, leveraging advanced analytics and AI-enabled approaches to improve the speed, scale, and quality of insight generation, enabling, better talent, workforce, and organizational decisions.

The role is responsible for Fortive's employee listening strategy and workforce intelligence capability, including the processes, methodologies, reporting, and resources that support enterprise and OpCo decision-making. Through analysis of workforce trends, employee sentiment, organizational effectiveness, skills, automation, and future workforce needs, the role helps Talent Partners, HRBPs, and leaders identify risks, evaluate options, and prioritize actions.

OPERATING MODEL

1 EMPLOYEE LISTENING & EXPERIENCE INSIGHT

2 PEOPLE & ORGANIZATION INTELLIGENCE

3 GOVERNANCE, PRODUCTS & ENABLEMENT

Own the listening strategy and convert employee feedback into potential action.

Connect people, work, organization, and technology data to illuminate decisions.

Create scalable standards, resources, and clear enterprise service commitments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

WORKFORCE INTELLIGENCE & OPERATING MODEL


Establish and continuously improve Fortive's Workforce Intelligence operating model, including services, governance, delivery standards, and stakeholder expectations.
Define and deliver a clear portfolio of workforce intelligence products, insights, resources, and support for Talent Partners and HRBPs.
Develop scalable methodologies, tools, and self-service resources that strengthen data-driven decision making across Fortive, including AI-enabled intelligence products and analytical approaches that improve insight generation, pattern detection, forecasting.
Partner with HR Technology, HR Operations, and data owners to improve data quality, usability, and reporting effectiveness.


EMPLOYEE LISTENING & ORGANIZATIONAL INSIGHT


Own Fortive's employee listening strategy, including listening priorities, survey and pulse programs, governance, reporting, and insight generation.
Partner with VP, Talent Planning & Capability as well as Talent Partners to identify critical workforce questions and translate business needs into focused listening and analytical plans.
Analyze employee sentiment, engagement, retention, organizational health, and workforce trends to identify opportunities, risks, and root causes.
Translate complex findings into practical recommendations that enable Talent Partners and HRBPs to take targeted action with business leaders.


WORKFORCE & ORGANIZATION ANALYTICS


Generate enterprise and OpCo insights across workforce, talent, skills, succession, mobility, performance, and employee experience data.
Provide Talent Partners and HRBPs with data-driven recommendations that inform talent reviews, workforce planning, succession discussions, organizational effectiveness, and capability decisions.
Apply AI-enabled and advanced analytical techniques to synthesize structured and unstructured workforce data, identify emerging patterns and risks, develop scenarios, and generate decision-relevant insights.
Analyze organization and work patterns to inform organization design, workforce productivity, automation, AI adoption, and capability planning.
Integrate multiple data sources into dashboards, reporting, and advanced analyses that enable better talent, workforce, and business decisions.


SCOPE & DECISION RIGHTS

OWNS

INFLUENCES

DOES NOT OWN


Enterprise employee listening strategy
Workforce Intelligence methods, standards, resources, and service commitments
Analytical quality, interpretation, validation, and responsible use of AI-enabled workforce intelligence methods
Employee experience and organizational effectiveness priorities
Workforce, organization design, automation, and capability choices
Talent, workforce planning, and action priorities
Data and technology requirements
Employee listening platforms or HR technology
OpCo talent, workforce, or organization strategy
Business staffing, organization design, or automation decisions
Enterprise HR data governance outside the role's scope
Leaders’ accountability for workforce and employee outcomes


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in industrial-organizational psychology, organizational research, analytics, data science, economics, human resources, or a related discipline preferred.
8+ years of experience in data analytics with a preference for people or workforce analytics, employee listening, organizational research, workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, consulting, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience managing employee listening or survey programs preferred, as well as translating quantitative and qualitative findings into practical action.
Strong analytical capability, including statistical analysis, trend identification, data visualization, and integration of multiple forms of evidence.
Demonstrated ability to apply AI-enabled analytical tools and methods to workforce or business questions, combined with the judgment to validate outputs, recognize limitations, protect sensitive information, and ensure responsible human oversight.
Experience developing executive-level dashboards, reports, and decision-support materials that make complex topics clear and actionable.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, project management, and influencing skills, with the ability to establish credibility with senior leaders and diverse HR partners.
Experience operating effectively in a global, matrixed environment and handling sensitive workforce and employee information with sound judgment and discretion.

Title: Sr Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Global Data Center Ops Central Insight and Analytics Team
Description:
Description

We are looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to build the diagnostic analytics layer for Amazon's global data center operations. You will move our analytics capability beyond reporting *what* happened to explaining *why* — identifying which factors drive metric deviation, decomposing performance into attributable components, and building the analytical frameworks that enable operational leaders to take the right action.

GDCO operates one of the world's largest physical infrastructure fleets — hundreds of data centers across 20+ countries — with thousands of technicians performing hardware repairs, rack installations, and preventive maintenance daily. We have strong descriptive analytics (dashboards, WBR metrics), but has opportunity in terms of explaining root causes, attribute performance gaps to specific factors, or recommend proven corrective actions. This leader will focus on building that diagnostic layer.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role. You will scope analytical problems, build decomposition frameworks, partner with operational leaders to validate findings, and deliver insights that directly influence resource allocation, process design, and investment decisions at the VP level. You'll work with rich operational data at scale: millions of repair tickets, rack lifecycle events, parts inventory flows, workforce scheduling data, and hardware validation results.

Basic Qualifications


10+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
Expert SQL skills — complex analytical queries across large-scale datasets (multi-system joins, window functions, statistical aggregations across petabyte-scale data)
Strong statistical foundation — regression analysis, statistical process control, hypothesis testing, and metric decomposition applied to real business problems
Experience building automated, reproducible analytical pipelines — scheduled systems that serve ongoing business processes at production quality
Proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and visualization
Demonstrated ability to decompose complex business metrics into attributable components — translating "this metric moved" into "here's why, here's who owns each piece, here's the impact"
Strong written and verbal communication — ability to write diagnostic narratives and present complex analysis clearly to VP-level audiences


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
Experience in operational analytics — manufacturing, logistics, field operations, supply chain, or physical infrastructure domains where you've analyzed process efficiency, failure modes, or workforce productivity
Experience with workforce analytics — productivity measurement, skill-gap analysis, labor planning, or efficiency modeling that accounts for varying task complexity and work mix
Experience building composite metrics or indices that combine multiple dimensions into weighted scores (similar to OEE, NPS, or operational health indices)
Experience with multivariate analysis — identifying which factors among many are most strongly associated with performance outcomes
Experience building decision-support tools, recommendation frameworks, or analytical playbooks — structured systems where analysis directly translates to operational action
Familiarity with forecasting methods (time-series decomposition, trend analysis, seasonality modeling) for operational planning
Experience building analytical frameworks adopted across multiple teams — reusable tools and methods that scale beyond individual analyses
Experience with Amazon internal data tools (Redshift, Athena, QuickSight) is a plus for internal candidates
Experience with data center, cloud infrastructure, or hardware operations is valuable but not required — domain knowledge can be learned; analytical rigor cannot

Title: Clinical Data Analyst, Spotfire
Description:
SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Bothell, WA and Princeton, NJ. It specializes in developing innovative cancer treatments using its established drug development platforms, focusing on bi-specific, multi-specific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). SystImmune has multiple assets in various stages of clinical trials for solid tumor and hematologic indications. Alongside ongoing clinical trials. SystImmune has a robust preclinical pipeline of potential cancer therapeutics in the discover and IND-enabling stages, representing cutting-edge biologics development. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company's success.

The Spotfire Clinical Data Analyst will specialize in the installation, maintenance, and development of clinical data visualizations utilizing Spotfire. This role emphasizes creating and enhancing Spotfire-based patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and other customized visualization reports such as live TLFs. Additionally, the Analyst will collaborate closely with Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Science, and Clinical Operations to optimize data visualization strategies.

This position requires a full-time onsite presence at our Redmond, WA office.

Responsibilities:


Lead the installation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of Spotfire for clinical data analysis and visualization
Design, develop, and maintain Spotfire dashboards for patient profiles, real-time clinical data review, surveillance, metrics tracking, and other customized visualizations
Develop sophisticated, interactive visualizations to support internal data review processes, surveillance, reconciliation, and reporting needs
Collaborate with Clinical Data Managers, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Clinical Science teams to identify requirements and translate them into effective Spotfire visualizations
Manage and continually improve the Spotfire analytics environment, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and performance
Establish and maintain a Global Spotfire Library, aligning visualization standards across multiple studies and programs
Train and mentor Clinical Data Managers and other stakeholders in effectively utilizing Spotfire dashboards and reports
Coordinate timelines and deliverables with Clinical Data Management and other cross-functional teams to ensure visualizations meet expectations
Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of new technologies and methodologies to enhance Spotfire capabilities
Document visualization specifications, maintain clear documentation for Spotfire-related processes, and contribute to departmental SOPs
Uphold industry standards including protocol compliance, ICH GCP, FDA regulations, and CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM)


Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Biostatistics, Computer Science, Life Science, or a related field
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Spotfire visualization development and administration in a clinical trial setting, preferably in oncology and hematology
Expert-level proficiency in Spotfire including installation, configuration, dashboard development, data integration, scripting (IronPython, TERR, etc.) and performance optimization
Strong experience developing patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and complex reports
Experience with SAS/R, SQL programming, and data manipulation
Familiarity with clinical trial data standards (CDISC SDTM, ADaM), experience with TLF generation preferred
Experience integrating Spotfire with clinical databases and EDC systems (e.g., Medidata RAVE, Oracle Inform, Veeva)
Strong organizational skills, critical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Familiarity with regulatory guidelines including GCP, ICH, and FDA requirements
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)


Compensation and Benefits:

The expected base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $130,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and skills.
