Title: Data Analyst - SQL / Databricks
Description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability.

Your Opportunity


You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks.
You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals.
This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment.
Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries.


What You'll Need


2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role.
To be considered for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria: Hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Columbia, MD office three days a week, or hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Boston, MA office three days a week.
Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering.
Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake.
Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets.
A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users.


And Ideally


Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools.
Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team.
Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git.
Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.


This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clair

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

About The Role

We’re looking for a top-tier analytics professional to deliver insights that drive growth. As a Senior Data Analyst at Clair, you’ll join a growing team of data practitioners who are passionate about bringing financial security to underserved communities by giving workers access to their earnings right when they need them. As a trusted thought partner to product and business teams, you’ll surface impactful insights supporting their goals. Through experimentation, analysis, modeling, and dashboard development, you’ll surface recommendations to enable Clair to reach millions of hourly workers and help them get paid on demand.

The ideal candidate will consider themselves a “full stack” data analyst with experience across the entire data pipeline, including data ingestion, processing, modeling, and visualization. This person will be comfortable with the analytics engineering workflow, mixing technical proficiency with the ability to engage stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Leverage data to drive user growth, identify trends, and influence product and business decisions
Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to address key analytical questions and evaluate hypotheses, leveraging data to drive innovation and novel solutions.
Define and manage key metrics that inform strategic product, growth, and operational decisions, ensuring alignment with business goals
Put data at the fingertips of stakeholders and enable them to independently explore and utilize data
Build efficient data ingestion and transformation pipelines using tools like dbt
Develop intuitive dashboards, memos, slides, and other visualizations that tell stories and inspire action
Collaborate to brainstorm ideas, verify analyses, and review the work of your peers to ensure accuracy and quality


Qualifications


4–5 years of professional experience in the data analytics field
Fluent in SQL (translating business questions to queries, understanding joins and functions, and building data pipelines)
Experience with experimentation and statistical analysis to guide decision-making
Passionate about building the best version of whatever you’re working on


Things We Consider a Plus


Experience with the modern data stack, including Snowflake, dbt, Tableau
Experience with a scripting language like Python or R
Interest in financial systems and consumer behavior
Experience with machine learning or statistical modeling
Experience in a high-growth start-up environment


Additional Details

Location: This is a hybrid position based out of New York City, you will be expected to come into the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, & Thursdays) with additional days on occasion for client meetings.

Compensation: The annual base salary for this role is $150,000-$160,000. The base pay for this role is determined using many factors, such as education, skills and experience and is reflective of Clair Series stage and size. Base pay is only one part of Clair’s competitive total compensation package which includes equity, benefits and additional perks. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Clair will only contact candidates from @getclair.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you happen to receive anything suspicious, please ignore it.

Need more convincing?

Benefits

Apart from getting to work with our incredible team, here are some of the benefits you can expect when you join Clair:


Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage, with option to extend to your family
Fully-paid parental leave
Company-sponsored 401k, HSA, and FSA
Unlimited vacation for salaried roles, generous PTO for hourly roles
Work from home setup allowance
Access to your earnings every day on Clair
Company-sponsored short-term and long-term disability insurance


Equal Opportunity Employer Information

Clair is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For questions, please email us at careers@getclair.com

Title: Analyste principal de données / Senior Data Analyst - CX
Description:
Aperçu du poste :

Genetec recherche actuellement un analyste principal de données pour son organisation dédiée à l'expérience client (CX). Nous recherchons une personne dynamique et réactive, capable de s'épanouir dans un environnement dynamique et animé, et de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables.

À ce poste, le candidat apportera son soutien à l'équipe CX Shared Services (CXSS) en jouant un rôle clé dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des activités de reporting et d'analyse, depuis la collecte des besoins et l'extraction des données jusqu'à la création et la diffusion de rapports automatisés. Ce poste permettra à l'organisation CX de Genetec de se démarquer en fournissant à ses collaborateurs des indicateurs détaillés, des analyses et des calculs approfondis et précis, ainsi que des présentations claires facilitant la prise de décision. Ces rapports, analyses et présentations seront étroitement liés aux performances de nos opérations CX, les données provenant de bases de données issues de différents systèmes (CRM, ERP, portail Web, IVR, chat, etc.). Ce poste exige de solides compétences en matière d'intégration, de validation et d'interprétation des données.



Votre journée en un coup d'oeil :

Recueillir les besoins en matière d'analyses, de rapports et de présentations auprès des différentes parties prenantes au sein de l'organisation CX et les traduire en spécifications techniques

Description:
Description

University Health Network (UHN) is hiring a Data Analyst to work in the growing field of Healthcare Value Based Care. This position offers a hybrid work from home option for employees who meet performance requirements. Candidate must reside in the Knoxville, Tennessee metropolitan area and be able to commute to the corporate office located in Knoxville, TN when needed. Candidate must be able to maintain HIPAA privacy requirements when working in a home office setting.

University Health Network is a clinically integrated network and manages University Health ACO, LLC (an accountable care organization). We work in partnership with the University of Tennessee Medical Center, University Physicians’ Association (UPA), area physicians, and commercial and Medicare insurance companies. We strive to deliver the healthcare triple aim: Better care for individuals, better health for populations, and lowering growth in expenditures.

Benefits Include


Remote Work Opportunity
Medical (including HDHP options), Dental, Vision, Life Insurance
FSA and HSA with employer contribution
Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
Onsite Fitness Center
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
401K Match with Immediate Vesting


Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The Data Analyst is a full-time position that is responsible for analyzing large sets of data from multiple sources. The Data Analyst creates and validates multiple weekly and monthly end user reports. They will also monitor process performance, satisfaction of our customers, and identify improvements in data collection that will better meet the needs of the department. Experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, and ETL processes is highly desired. This position reports to the Manager of Data Analytics.

Requirements


BS in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics, or relevant field desired.
Proven working experience as a data analyst or similar role required. Will consider education in lieu of work experience.
Proficiency in programming languages including SQL and Python.
Proficiency using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Familiarity with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes desired.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Title: HEALTHCARE DATA ANALYST
Description:
This position develops and maintains reports, dashboards, scorecards, and performance metrics; analyzes organizational data; ensures data accuracy and integrity; and provides actionable insights to executive leadership, physicians, department leaders, quality, finance, revenue cycle, clinical teams, and other stakeholders.


Expected pay for this position is $29.84-$44.75. Actual pay will be determined by experience, skills and internal equity.
MDH Benefits package includes:
Medical, Dental, Vision
457B and employer match
Company paid STD and LTD
Job Summary
The Healthcare Data Analyst serves as an enterprise reporting and analytics resource, transforming healthcare data into meaningful information that supports strategic, operational, financial, clinical, quality, and regulatory decision-making.

The Healthcare Data Analyst will also promote standardized reporting practices, automation, documentation, and continuous improvement while supporting the long-term sustainability of the organization's reporting and decision-support processes.

Bachelor's degree required in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Accounting, Public Health, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.


Job Specifications
Education


Experience

Three years of progressively responsible experience preferred in healthcare analytics, business intelligence, decision support, data analysis, financial analysis, quality reporting, or healthcare operations. Hospital experience strongly preferred.

Technical Knowledge & Skills


Advanced Microsoft Excel
SQL and database concepts
Data analysis, statistical analysis, forecasting, and benchmarking
Data visualization and dashboard development
Microsoft Power BI preferred
Crystal Reports, SSRS, or equivalent reporting tools preferred
Microsoft Office Suite
Electronic Health Record reporting systems


Professional Skills


Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities
Excellent written and verbal communication
Ability to translate complex data into clear information for non-technical audiences
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Effective organization, prioritization, and problem-solving skills
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities
Strong customer-service and collaboration skills
Ability to maintain confidentiality


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Cerner or other EHR reporting tools
Experience with healthcare financial and revenue cycle reporting
Knowledge of CMS and healthcare quality measures
Experience developing dashboards and executive scorecards
Experience with healthcare benchmarking databases
Experience with healthcare budgeting, productivity, and operational analytics


Perinatal / Maternal Health – Preferred Bonus

Experience supporting perinatal, maternal, and neonatal health initiatives is highly preferred, particularly experience supporting public health grants or HRSA-funded programs.

The successful candidate will provide data support for the MDH MOMCare grant, including:


Managing and analyzing maternal and neonatal health data.
Supporting data collection, reporting, and grant compliance requirements.
Measuring program outcomes and developing reports to inform maternal health initiatives in rural communities.
Supporting quality measures, program evaluation, and evidence-based decision-making.
Collaborating with clinical and community partners on maternal health data needs.


Preferred perinatal experience includes Obstetrics, maternal/neonatal health, public health grants, HRSA-funded programs, quality measures, database analysis, programming, or grant administration.

Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, SPSS, SAS, R, Tableau, or Power BI is beneficial.

Performance Expectations

The Healthcare Data Analyst will:


Deliver accurate, timely, and reliable reporting.
Provide actionable analytics that support organizational decision-making.
Improve reporting efficiency through standardization and automation.
Maintain high standards of data integrity and validation.
Develop dashboards and reports that promote organizational transparency.
Support regulatory, quality, financial, clinical, and operational reporting needs.
Maintain clear documentation to ensure continuity of reporting processes.
Provide excellent service to hospital departments and leadership.
Maintain current knowledge of healthcare analytics, reporting technologies, and regulatory requirements.

Title: Data Analyst - Servicing Operations
Description:
As a Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support operations, call center, and servicing reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role


Identify and communicate patterns in operations and call center data in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on operations/servicing metrics and call center activity
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly operations and collections teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around operational performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among operations stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in operations, call center management, and data analytics


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

About Us

Headquartered in Detroit, Rocket Loans was established to create the most simple, rocket fast personal loan process. We assembled a top-notch team of individuals combining new, passionate team members with some of the best veterans from Rocket Mortgage to create the most user-friendly lending platform in the world. We have given it our best to create an experience that is best-of-breed in the personal loan industry and commit even more to continuously improving it. At Rocket Loans, you’ll build a career that helps you achieve your professional goals while helping clients get the loans they need to reach their financial goals. We’re looking for innovators and those unafraid to disrupt the status -quo. With an inclusive culture and opportunities to make a positive impact, we’re here to help you foster your career growth.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About JLG, An Oshkosh Company

JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.

As a member of the Data Analyst team, your primary responsibilities will be to identify, collect, process, and analyze datasets to help make informed business decisions. You will also assist with data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents.

YOUR IMPACT


Discover, acquire, explore, prepare, assess and maintain datasets from internal data sources to support analyses and ad-hoc investigative requests for projects which are function/business unit specific
Under limited supervision, responsible for data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents, including resolution of root causes.
Apply skills in SQL and statistical techniques to the acquisition, enrichment, and analysis of data.
Resolve incidents, changes, problems, tasks, and demands
Applies knowledge of process, people, product, data, and systems of related business functions within at least one business unit
Define Business Problems & Opportunities
Define Relevant Dimensions & Measures
Collaborating with Data Engineers, draft and test data views to meet business needs for projects
Collaborating with Data Scientists, learn and align on basic understanding of predictive and prescriptive analytics, as well as machine learning and artificial intelligence
Provide Data to Confirm Problems & Opportunities
Draft Goals, Roles, and Sustainment Plans
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. scientists, data engineers, business operations support, consultants) on data needs for solutions which may be projects focused on a single business function within a single business unit (Limited Complexity)
Apply technical writing and verbal communication skills to assist in the change management (e.g. training instructions) and on-going management of data solutions.
Actively participate in Function/Business Unit/Digital Technology Analytics Communities of Practice
Assist business' citizen analysts in building views and in analyzing, interpreting, and communicating data insights.



Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent.
Three (3) or more years of experience in Data Analysis, Information Technology, or in a related area.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Ability to travel 20%



Standout Qualifications


Experience in data analysis, analytics
Attention to detail, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
Analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Experience and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, and/or C#



WORKING CONDITIONS

The following represents general working conditions for this office-based role. Specific conditions may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances.


This role is primarily performed in a professional office environment with standard lighting, ventilation, and temperature-controlled settings.
Duties are largely sedentary, requiring extended periods of sitting and using a computer and telephone.
Visual acuity to operate a computer and read documents is required, along with auditory ability to participate in virtual and in-person meetings.
Occasional movement within the office environment is necessary, including walking short distances, standing, or reaching for files.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.



Pay Range

$73,200.00 - $117,800.00

The above pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. This individual will work closely with the Senior Program Manager, program leadership, and site-level operations teams to aggregate, analyze, and present program-wide performance data, support strategic planning activities, and ensure that all headquarters-level reporting requirements are met with accuracy and consistency. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:


Serve as the primary data analyst supporting headquarters-level program performance monitoring, aggregating and analyzing operational data from multiple call center sites to provide a comprehensive, enterprise-wide view of program performance.
Design, develop, and maintain advanced performance dashboards, scorecards, and analytical reports that provide senior program leadership and government stakeholders with timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into program-wide call center performance metrics.
Collect, validate, and consolidate operational data submissions from site-level operations teams, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and completeness of all data inputs prior to incorporation into headquarters-level reports and briefings.
Conduct in-depth analysis of program-wide operational data including call volumes, ticket trends, SLA compliance, first call resolution rates, escalation patterns, workforce utilization, and customer satisfaction scores, identifying cross-site trends, performance gaps, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Lead the preparation and quality assurance review of all headquarters-level customer-facing deliverables including monthly and quarterly performance reports, program scorecards, and executive briefing materials for senior government leadership.
Support the Senior Program Manager and headquarters leadership team in the development of data-driven strategic recommendations, program improvement initiatives, and resource allocation strategies informed by enterprise performance data.
Develop and maintain a program-wide operational metrics baseline and performance benchmarking framework, conducting regular comparisons across sites and against industry standards to identify best practices and areas requiring targeted improvement.
Collaborate with site-level operations analysts and program staff to ensure alignment of data definitions, reporting methodologies, and performance measurement standards across all program locations.
Support data governance activities including the development and enforcement of data quality standards, reporting templates, data dictionary maintenance, and analytical process documentation.
Assist in the management and continuous improvement of the program's data infrastructure, including ITSM platform reporting configurations, data extraction processes, and dashboard maintenance.
Prepare and present analytical findings, program performance summaries, and strategic recommendations to senior program leadership and government stakeholders in both written and verbal formats.
Respond to ad hoc data requests and analytical tasks from headquarters leadership and government stakeholders, delivering accurate, insightful, and well-presented outputs within established timelines.
Support continuous improvement initiatives at the headquarters level by identifying cross-site operational inefficiencies, analyzing root causes, and developing data-supported improvement recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities as needed, including supporting proposal efforts with program performance data, analytical capability narratives, and past performance documentation.

Education and Experience:


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Administration, Information Technology, Statistics, Operations Management, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
4+ years of experience in a data analysis, business intelligence, or operations analysis role, with demonstrated experience supporting enterprise-level or multi-site reporting functions.
Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining performance dashboards, analytical reports, and data visualization products for senior leadership and executive audiences.
Experience working within a federal government contracting environment.
Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources to produce consolidated, enterprise-level analytical outputs.


Preferred


Master's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field.
Prior experience supporting headquarters or enterprise-level data analysis functions for a federal IT call center, service desk, or IT managed services program.
Experience working in a high-visibility, senior leadership-facing analytical role within a government contracting environment.


Required Skills And Competencies


Exceptional communication skills in English – both written and oral – with the ability to present complex data findings, analytical insights, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive-level government stakeholders and senior program leadership.
Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to aggregate, validate, and interpret large volumes of multi-source operational data to identify enterprise-wide trends, performance patterns, and strategic improvement opportunities.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, dynamic charting, and macro development for sophisticated operational reporting and analysis.
Advanced proficiency in data visualization platforms such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools, with demonstrated experience designing executive-level dashboards and interactive, multi-site analytical reports.
Proficiency in data querying languages such as SQL for extracting, transforming, and analyzing data from relational databases and ITSM platforms.
Hands-on experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or equivalent systems, including experience extracting and analyzing platform data for enterprise reporting purposes.
Working knowledge of IT service management principles and ITIL frameworks, including SLA governance, incident management, and continuous service improvement.
Strong data governance skills with experience developing and enforcing data quality standards, reporting templates, and analytical process documentation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint for documentation, communication, and reporting purposes.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority deliverables simultaneously, maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced headquarters environment.
Ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance as required.


Desired Skills And Competencies


Active government security clearance (Secret or higher).
ITIL Foundation certification or higher (ITIL Intermediate or ITIL 4 Managing Professional).
Experience with advanced analytics or statistical programming languages such as Python or R for large-scale data analysis and modeling.
Lean Six Sigma White Belt, Yellow Belt, or Green Belt certification.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or demonstrated project management experience supporting analytical programs.
Experience with enterprise data warehouse platforms, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, or equivalent data integration tools.
Familiarity with federal IT governance frameworks and reporting requirements such as FITARA, FedRAMP, or NIST cybersecurity standards.
Experience supporting quality assurance (QA) programs and integrating customer satisfaction data into enterprise performance reporting frameworks.
Familiarity with workforce management platforms and call center performance analytics tools used in a multi-site operational environment.
Experience contributing to business development efforts including proposal writing, analytical capability development, and past performance documentation.
Knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and reporting within a federal contract environment.

Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with LSCC's leave policy and performs other duties as assigned.

May provide guidance to others.
Performs related work as assigned.

Experience in data, reporting or business analytics
Experience in gathering requirements for reporting

Knowledge of SQL preferred.

Some key factors that will make an individual successful in this role:


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Effective communication and collaboration with stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Competitive salary;

403b Employee Retirement Plan

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Job Description

As a Senior Business Data Analyst, you will support warehouse operations by transforming data into actionable insights that improve performance and efficiency. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build dashboards, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. In addition to core analytics work, you’ll have the opportunity to lead projects across multiple sites, support site startups, and act as a point of contact for analytics community initiatives.



Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions

Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health

Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise in operations/call center reporting and supporting operations teams with collections and call center activity metrics
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! Title: Data Analyst - SQL / Databricks
Description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability.

Your Opportunity


You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks.
You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals.
This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment.
Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries.


What You'll Need


2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role.
To be considered for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria: Hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Columbia, MD office three days a week, or hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Boston, MA office three days a week.
Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering.
Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake.
Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets.
A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users.


And Ideally


Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools.
Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team.
Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git.
Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.


This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs.

$72,500—$96,500 USD

Title: Claims - Data Analyst I - III
Description:
Make a difference with a career in insurance

At The Cincinnati Insurance Companies, we put people first and apply the Golden Rule to our daily operations. To put this into action, we’re looking for extraordinary people to join our talented team. Our service-oriented, ethical, knowledgeable, caring associates are the heart of our vision to be the best company serving independent agents. We help protect families and businesses as they work to prevent or recover from a loss. Share your talents to help us reach for continued success as we bring value to the communities we serve and demonstrate that Actions Speak Louder in Person®.

If you’re ready to build productive relationships, collaborate within a diverse team, embrace challenges and develop your skills, then Cincinnati may be the place for you. We offer career opportunities where you can contribute and grow.

Build your future with us

Our Claims Operations department is currently seeking a Claims Data Analyst I - III. A Claims Data Analyst is responsible for understanding and analyzing claims data, creating reports, completing data requests, identifying and interpreting data trends, and presenting results to stakeholders. This analyst will work closely with internal and external customers to translate business needs into clear requirements and deliver solutions. This role involves frequent collaboration with IT to enhance deliverables. As a Claims Data Analyst, the responsibilities scale with experience and proficiency, so the candidate can be expected to fulfill leadership roles on projects, mentor fellow team members, establish and maintain relationships with internal and external customers, and independently manage workload.

Starting pay: The pay range for this position is $55,000 - $90,000 annually. Pay is based on the applicant’s education, experience, location, knowledge, skills and abilities. Eligible associates may also receive an annual cash bonus and stock incentives based on company and individual performance.

Be Ready To


participate in or lead meetings with customers to understand data and reporting needs
build strong relationships with Claims leadership and stakeholders
create routine and ad hoc reports based on requests throughout the organization
develop and validate reports, dashboards, and large-scale trending analyses
extract and validate information from multiple data sources
perform statistical analyses for projects and summarize results
identify trends in data and provide actionable insights
partner with IT to investigate data discrepancies, resolve data issues, document requirements, and test system enhancements
understand how claims data is transformed from a source system to multiple downstream systems, including how the data is used in legacy systems, agency/insured portals, and in corporate data warehouses
help define and improve reporting processes
independently review and interpret data requests and follow through with timely reporting
ensure accuracy and consistency of claims data across data sources
serve as a subject matter expert for Claims data on corporate-level projects
explore and implement new reporting tools and solutions
proactively find ways to improve and automate processes, keeping efficiency at the forefront of work efforts
participate in peer review and mentor other analysts, depending on experience


Be Equipped With


the ability to proactively identify, build, and maintain relationships with stakeholders
strong problem-solving skills
keen attention to detail
clear written and verbal communication skills
ability to present complex information in an understandable and compelling manner
fluency with advanced Microsoft® Excel functionality including pivot tables, Power Query, combination charts, vlookups, and complex calculations
experience with data analysis, reporting, and creating queries to extract data
knowledge of Power BI or other data visualization software preferred
ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines independently
quick to learn new technical concepts and adapt to change
focus on improving processes and finding efficiencies
experience with or willingness to learn Excel macros, VBA, or other common coding languages (i.e. SAS, SQL, or DAX, etc.)


Bring Education And Experience From


qualified candidates have earned a bachelor's degree in business, mathematics, statistics or information technology-related fields or related experience
preferred knowledge of insurance industry and risk management
professional insurance designations are preferred but not necessary
knowledge of statistical analyses
familiar with data models and tools like PowerPivot
preferably 2+ years hands-on experience with reporting tools like SAP Business Warehouse, Power BI, Cognos or other tools for analytics and reporting
experience using SAS, R, SPSS or other statistical packages is desirable


Enhance your talents

Providing outstanding service and developing strong relationships with our independent agents are hallmarks of our company. Whether you have experience from another carrier or you’re new to the insurance industry, we promote a lifelong learning approach. Cincinnati provides you with the tools and training to be successful and to become a trusted, respected insurance professional – all while enjoying a meaningful career.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Overview

Turn raw data into insights that National Guard leaders act on every day. As our BI Analyst on DA2I, you'll build Qlik Sense dashboards and data models that drive decisions at the highest levels of the client organization, with room to work hands-on in Palantir Foundry and shape BI standards across the team. If you're energized by cutting-edge tools and mission-critical impact, we want to hear from you.

FWI is building a team to support the National Guard Bureau's (NGB) Minuteman Community Space and as BI professional, you will play a crucial role in building Qlik Sense data models and dashboard visualization solutions in support of mission-critical work for the National Guard. If you are passionate about leveraging your BI skills, have a curious and analytical mindset, and enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies to enable efficient data analysis, we encourage you to apply.

Work Schedule and Location:

On-Site: This full-time position will work Monday through Friday, in Arlington, VA.

Responsibilities


Create data visualizations and dashboards to present insights to end-users, driving improved decision-making for leaders at the highest levels of the client organization
Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities, becoming an expert in the data and its applications
Follow and enhance BI standards across the team, including keeping up to date with Qlik Sense product enhancements and best practices
Ensure optimal end-user performance by establishing and consistently executing overall system performance assessment processes and associated action plans
Support the design and development of data models, ensuring data integrity and relevance
Communicate and coordinate with teams to accomplish objectives and deliver excellence
Proactively identify opportunities to drive analysis forward and present actionable insights to National Guard customers


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:


3-10 years of directly related experience and a B.A./B.S. or M.A./M.S. in a related field
Professional dashboard-development experience using business intelligence software such as Qlik Sense, Tableau, or Power BI
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality results
Must possess an active Secret clearance at minimum


Preferred Qualifications


Recent DoW experience
Previous experience with Advana or the War Data Platform
3+ years of experience with Qlik Sense data modeling and building dashboards and data visualizations
3+ years of experience with Qlik Sense, including styling Qlik Sense apps using CSS
Familiarity with database systems, SQL queries, and programming languages such as Python
Experience building within Palantir Foundry applications, including Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia

CDI


SIBYLONE, société de conseil spécialisée dans les systèmes d’information de synthèse et de pilotage, aide ses clients à tirer toute la valeur de leur patrimoine de données, levier stratégique majeur de développement et de rentabilité.

Notre ambition : rendre les différents acteurs de l’entreprise autonomes dans l’exploitation des données, libérer les usages Métier, pour qu’ils soient en mesure de relever les défis de performance, de couverture de risque, de financement, de conquête client, de RSE… qui s’imposent à eux.

SIBYLONE emploie environ 200 salariés et réalise un chiffre d’affaires de 30 millions d’euros en fournissant des services de haute qualité à de grandes entreprises.

SIBYLONE est une Filiale du Groupe Smart 4 Engineering : Créé en 2020, le groupe compte aujourd’hui 12 marques en France, en Italie, en Espagne et au Portugal dans le domaine de l’ingénierie et de l’IT. Avec près de 3 500 ingénieurs et consultants hautement qualifiés, nous offrons des services dans des domaines porteurs comme le Digital, la Data, l’Intelligence Artificielle, la Cybersécurité, le Cloud et le Software.

Avec nos 3,000 ingénieurs / consultants hautement qualifiés, le Groupe offre ses services dans les domaines très porteurs du Digital, de la Data, de l’Intelligence Artificielle, de la Cybersécurité, du Cloud et des Logiciels.

Contexte

Au sein de la DSI Corporate, l’équipe Dataviz & Reporting accompagne les différents métiers de l’entreprise dans l’analyse de données et la production de reporting stratégiques. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst maîtrisant les outils SQL, Power BI et Alteryx pour renforcer notre équipe.

Vos missions

Title: Data Analyst Power BI / GCP H/F
Description:
Qui sommes-nous ?



Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale.



Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées.





Description du poste



NEXTON recrute un Data Analyst Power BI / GCP H/F, en CDI, à Paris !



Ton futur environnement de travail :



Tu intègres l'équipe en tant que Data Analyst pour l'un de nos clients grands comptes du secteur bancaire.



Tes missions :



Identifier, extraire et collecter des données provenant de différentes sources (bases de données, systèmes internes, API externes, etc.).
Effectuer des analyses statistiques et quantitatives pour comprendre les tendances et identifier les opportunités d'optimisation.
Créer des rapports et des dashboards interactifs à l’aide d’outils tels que Power BI afin de communiquer les résultats de manière claire et compréhensible.
Assurer la qualité des données en les nettoyant et en les structurant pour les rendre exploitables.
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes décisionnelles pour les aider à interpréter les données et prendre des décisions informées.
Automatiser les processus d’analyse et de reporting via des scripts ou des outils spécialisés
Se tenir informé des nouvelles méthodes et outils d'analyse de données pour optimiser les processus existants.







Qualifications



De formation supérieure (BAC+5), tu possèdes au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst dans un environnement Agile/SCRUM.



Tu as une excellente capacité à développer et documenter tes analyses (data sourcing, hypothèses et méthodes analytiques) dans une logique Lean & Agile.



Tu as une forte expérience en préparation de données (Big Query, PowerBI) en particulier sur une modern data stack.



Tu maîtrises les statistiques et les visualisations de données.





Informations supplémentaires



Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ?



Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année :



▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours.



▶ Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences.



▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser.



▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir.



▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce.



▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté.



Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous !

Advanced proficiency in Spanish (written and spoken).

Unlock your full potential, both professionally and personally.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you see the benefits of gaining variety and experience from different customers and industries but developing with one and the same employer? As an employee at ESSIQ, you get the best of both worlds.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst with a strong technical foundation in data engineering to join our team. In this role, you’ll manage multiple data and reporting solutions across different technologies.

You’ll work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams — acting as the key bridge between business needs and data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights: Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and insights that drive informed decision-making.

Visualization & Reporting: Design and develop dashboards and reports in Power BI to communicate insights effectively.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Data Engineers and Data Scientists to turn business requirements into actionable data models and analytics solutions.

Required Skills & Experience


Strong proficiency in SQL and Power BI
Proven experience in Business Intelligence or Advanced Analytics projects
Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills
Experience in requirement gathering, process understanding, and solution design


Soft Skills & Working Style


Strong interpersonal and cross-cultural communication skills
Comfortable collaborating across international teams and time zones
Adaptable, proactive, and eager to learn new technologies and methodologies
Skilled in virtual collaboration tools for effective teamwork in global settings


About Essiq

ESSIQ is the technology consultancy where everything starts with the individual. We offer you the opportunity to shape your own career, a modern salary policy and flexible solutions! ESSIQ was founded in 2005 and has since grown with over 130 employees and three offices that you can find in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö. With us, you have the opportunity to work on site with the client, in-house and in satellite. Your interests and driving forces lead the way and our goal is to make the perfect match between individual and mission.

ESSIQ is a social company. We put a lot of resources into community and we have a wide range of professional and social activities. Our communication platform is imbued with openness and promotes networking and skill exchange as well as leisure activities and relationship building.

APPLICATION

Selection and interviews will take place continuously, so send your application today! Please respect that we do not accept any applications by email.

Questions about the role? Contact: Fredrik Persson, fredrik.persson@essiq.se

Do you want to know more about ESSIQ? Visit http://essiq.se and follow us on our social media!

SQL

Tickets restaurant.

Connaissances en modélisation et manipulation de données.

💡 OVENTI Consulting, cabinet de conseil en Data et Intelligence Artificielle qui allie expertise technique de pointe, vision stratégique et accompagnement sur mesure. Nous couvrons tout le cycle de vie des projets Data/IA, de la stratégie à l'implémentation de solutions personnalisées (ML, BI, automatisation intelligente).

Nos équipes, issues des meilleures écoles, s'intègrent chez nos clients ou opèrent depuis notre LAB interne, véritable foyer d’innovation. Chez Oventi, nous privilégions le "sur mesure" et l'innovation concrète. Chaque collaborateur est accompagné, formé et suivi pour garantir une culture d'excellence et un impact réel.




🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.




🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.




Définition de stratégies :

Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.




Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.




Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence




🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

8 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.




🌟 Pourquoi rejoindre OVENTI ?

Rejoindre Oventi, c'est choisir une aventure professionnelle unique :




✔️Une structure à taille humaine : Favorisant l'échange, l'autonomie et l'innovation, où votre impact est direct et visible.

✔️Des missions à forte valeur ajoutée : Dans des secteurs variés, avec une approche "sur mesure" où nos solutions ont des impacts importants chez nos clients.

✔️Une culture d’excellence technique : Avec un réel accompagnement de carrière et un suivi personnalisé.

✔️Une équipe passionnée et engagée : Des ingénieurs recrutés avec soin, formés en continu, et investis sur le long terme.

✔️L’agilité d’une startup, la rigueur d’un cabinet expert : Le meilleur des deux mondes pour une expérience enrichissante.

✔️Des missions à impact, visibles et valorisantes : Où vous aurez un impact réel sur les décisions métiers et la valeur business générée.




📍 Localisation : Paris (75002) avec 2-3 jours de télétravail hebdomadaire

💶 Rémunération : A discuter selon vos prétentions

🗓️ Démarrage : ASAP
